svg.title: What LEVI does with robot data, from reading it to a better policy
svg.desc: A five-tier pyramid: read and convert, check, label and judge, curate for training, and a better policy at the top, which is not established. The measured result sits at the label-and-judge tier.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From raw data to a better policy

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each tier rests on the one below it. The top tier is the goal, and it is not proven yet.
